errors.msg: Signer is not the pending authority

errors.name: UnexpectedRemainingAccountsKind
errors.msg: Unexpected remaining accounts kind for this instruction

types.name: DynamicFeeConfig
docs: Per-`bin_step` dynamic-fee parameters, sourced from `utils::constraints` at pool

fields.name: filter_period
docs: Swaps arriving faster than this apart, in seconds, don't move the reference.

fields.name: decay_period
docs: Window after which, absent activity, the reference decays instead of resetting.

fields.name: dynamic_fee_control
docs: Scales the squared volatility accumulator into a fee rate, over `DYNAMIC_FEE_DIVISOR`.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_RATE
docs: Hard ceiling on `base fee_rate + variable fee_rate` combined (10%). Must equal
`constraints.rs`' top `FEE_RATES` entry — enforced there via a compile-time assertion.

constants.name: MAX_PROTOCOL_SHARE
docs: Maximum protocol share of a swap fee, in basis points (25%).
